sql: SELECT multiIf(d.CalendarDayOfWeekNumber IN (1,7), 'Weekend', 'Weekday') AS DayType, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales, sum(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0 / sum(sum(f.SalesAmount)) OVER () AS Percentage FROM retail.FactSales AS f INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey GROUP BY DayType ORDER BY DayType
